items.description: Task 9 requires a test that fails on any L3 or draft condition in a bullet that must itself say "at L3 with `--merge-guard off`" and "no draft call", without defining what counts as a condition, so two word-list tests failed review and the task was blocked and needed a third, adviser-led attempt with an exact-string pin.

items.description: Task 8 says any unreadable timeline halts at engage while Task 4 defines unreadable to include a short timeline and has engage_decision halt only on a failed or incomplete read, so the ref followed the plan wording, contradicted the code, and Task 8 failed review 2 and needed a repair.

items.plan_quote: Exit report (the `merge_guard` field mapping of `guard_status`, the held-exit list with the clear command
items.description: Task 8 defines the exit-report field only as the guard_status mapping (Task 3: no record at ordinal 3 gives `released`) and drops the source rule that a `draft_guard_unavailable` halt reports `unavailable`, so the ref would report `released` after an engage halt and Task 8 review 1 failed on it.

Task 3 requires guard_status to return `user_override` for a DISABLED phase with cause user_override, but the fold rows it implements set `disabled_cause` only for already_draft, so the advisory plan review raised blocking finding R1-1 and the owner had to accept building with executor guidance instead of a plan fix.
